summary: Build practical hunting skills with ATT&CK, SIEM analysis, and intelligence workflows. Enroll in the 5-day course.
lede: Threat intelligence and cyber threat hunting turn adversary information and security telemetry into targeted searches for hidden compromise. For security professionals, this course develops practical skills in forming hunt hypotheses, correlating endpoint, network and identity evidence with threat intelligence, and reporting findings with remediation recommendations.
audienceIntro: This course is built for security professionals who need to investigate adversary behavior, validate suspicious activity, and convert threat intelligence into practical hunt actions.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: working knowledge of cybersecurity fundamentals, common attack surfaces, log sources, and incident response workflows. Familiarity with SIEM concepts, Windows Event Logs, Linux auth logs, packet or endpoint telemetry, and basic threat intelligence terminology will help you move faster. No coding is required for completion, although comfort with query-driven tools and structured analysis is useful. Advanced hunting concepts are taught at operational application level, with selected topics such as automation and enrichment introduced at conceptual awareness level.
